thread:
maria: Heads-up — we need to lock the Advice Recipebook scope for Optimize by Thu exec sync. Customer asks landed: smarter batching policies, prefix/KV ephemeral caching guidance, quantization recommendation tiers, plus eval-triggered alerts. Can we converge on priorities?
jon: Proposed split: 1) core heuristics (batch + cache), 2) quant recs + profiles, 3) ops/integration (eval alerts + runbook). Deliver each lane independently.
alex: Acceptance criteria suggestion: measurable econ AND latency guardrails. Example: >=15% token cost drop on bench OR <5% p99 latency regression; quant recs must show <2% quality delta on benchmark. Pilot with acmehealth + shoply.
sam: For eval alerts we need a deterministic pipeline: eval run -> metric delta -> thresholding -> severity tag -> action (notify / auto-rollback). Example config snippet: ```yaml
alert_name: answer_concordance_drop
metric: concordance_v0.9
baseline: run_2026_03_01
thresholds:
  - severity: low
    delta_pct: 3
  - severity: high
    delta_pct: 8
actions:
  low: notify(#product, #support)
  high: start-rollback: true
```
maria: Good. Ops question: should high severity trigger automatic quant fallback (to higher-precision) or just pause rollout? We need policy documented.
alex: Automatic fallback ok if: severity == high AND observed in 2 consecutive eval windows. Otherwise pause + human-in-the-loop. Manual override allowed.
jon: I'll draft a short checklist for release gates: 1) bench econ pass, 2) p99 latency SLO pass, 3) telemetry implemented, 4) eval-alert wiring + runbook, 5) 2 pilot customers signoff.
sam: Telemetry fields we need: batch_size_hist, cache_hit_rate, quant_profile, eval_version, request_route. Also include per-customer cost_estimate delta.
deploy-bot: FYI: canary window booked for dedicated cluster on 2026-04-12 02:00UTC — will ping #eng-oncall on deploy start.
maria: Prioritization: core heuristics + basic quant recs this quarter; eval-triggered alerts as soft gate for GA (must exist and be wired for pilots). Defer UI surfaced recommendations to Q3.
jon: :thumbsup: will post PRD draft by EOD and include gating checklist.
alex: I'll own telemetry + rollout automation tasks.
sam: I'll write the eval->alert playbook and example alert configs for customers.
maria: Thanks team. Quick follow-up: let's include explicit rollback TTL (how long we keep fallback active) and an incident play template for false positives. I'll add those to the PRD.
jon: Noted — adding rollback TTL and false-positive checklist.
alex: One last ask: document per-customer tier behavior (free = advisory-only, standard = advisory + opt-in automation, enterprise = automated with SLA).
maria: Perfect — that distinction should live in the runbook and customer onboarding checklist. We'll review in today’s triage.
